text:
Shane Pinto is giving Ottawa the goals it needs during a hot run. He scored twice against Colorado on his birthday, including the overtime winner, and has seven goals in his last 10 games as the Senators went 4-0-1 in five. He's playing more too, about 21 minutes a night lately, and he has 40 hits.

The scoring rate needs a caution: nine goals on 8.1 expected (the quality of his chances), shooting 21% against a range for him nearer 15%. His chances are up, though, so this isn't all luck. The part to watch is the other end. Ottawa has 49% of the expected goals at five on five with him on the ice, nearly six points worse than without him, and Evolving-Hockey noted last season that he plays with strong teammates, which flatters his raw numbers.

He's a two-way centre in a big role on a team at 89% to make the playoffs in our simulations. Watch whether the chances against settle down as the goals cool.
